name: Store Builder

summary: Job-led storefront promoted to the main preview; 14/15 source checks pass. Homepage collections, PDP validation modules and catalogue mapping are implemented while commerce remains disabled.
blocker: Commercial launch still waits on validated suppliers, landed cost, final assets, fit/spec data, fulfillment, traceability and owner GO.
